name: dish-tabbouleh-season
subject: Tabbouleh of finely chopped parsley topped with diced tomato, on lettuce leaves with lemon slices, in a white bowl on weathered wood; spoons of paprika and dried herbs behind
altEn: Parsley tabbouleh crowned with diced tomato and lemon slices, on lettuce leaves on a wooden table
altAr: تبولةُ بقدونسٍ مفروم تعلوها مكعّباتُ الطماطم وشرائحُ الليمون، على أوراق خسٍّ فوق طاولةٍ خشبية
notes: Unsplash, Chez Le Libanais. Even soft light; warm wood. 4:5 crop centred on the bowl drops the spice spoons top-right.

name: dish-hassawi-kabsa
subject: Top-down: long-grain spiced rice with a whole roasted, turmeric-yellow meat piece in a large silver tray on dark stone; small bowls of broth, red daqqus sauce and tea; brass spoons, terracotta linen; a bowl of luqaimat top-left
altEn: Spiced rice topped with roasted meat in a silver tray, with small bowls of broth and red tomato sauce
altAr: أرزٌّ متبّل تعلوه قطعةُ لحمٍ مشويّة في صينيةٍ فضية، وحولها أوعيةُ مرقٍ وصلصةِ دقّوس
notes: Unsplash, aboodi vesakaran. Gulf-style mandi/kabsa styling (tray, daqqus, brass); rice is pale, not the red Hassawi rice, and the meat reads as chicken/lamb - acceptable stand-in. Crop 4:5 centred on tray.

name: dish-eggs-east-wall
subject: Top-down: three sunny-side-up eggs in a black speckled cast pan on a white gas hob
altEn: Three sunny-side-up eggs with deep orange yolks in a black pan
altAr: ثلاثُ بيضاتٍ مقليّة بصفارٍ برتقاليٍّ عميق في مقلاةٍ سوداء
notes: Unsplash, Hasan Almasi. No tomato/sausage visible - plain fried eggs stand-in; hob is cool white, grade warm and crop tight to the pan (4:5 inside the pan rim). Rejected a skillet frame with a breakfast sausage patty (possible pork).

name: dish-akkawi-manakish
subject: Top-down: round white-cheese flatbread cut into eight wedges with flecks of green herb, on a round wooden board over dark slate, woven mat and jute rope to the right
altEn: Round cheese flatbread cut into wedges on a wooden board
altAr: خبزٌ مستدير بالجبن الأبيض مقطّعٌ أثلاثًا على لوحٍ خشبي
notes: Unsplash, Husien Bisky. Cheese manakish stand-in (herb flecks, no visible nigella). Crop 4:5 on the board, dropping the faux plant top-right and the potted plant bottom-left.

name: dish-tamees-foul
subject: Beans simmering in a red, cumin-and-pepper-flecked sauce in a battered pot over an open fire; a flatbread toasting on the griddle behind, steam rising
altEn: Beans simmering in a spiced tomato sauce in a blackened pot, flatbread toasting on the griddle behind
altAr: فولٌ يغلي في صلصةٍ متبّلة داخل قدرٍ مسودٍّ من النار، وخلفه رغيفٌ يتحمّص على الصاج
notes: Unsplash, P.O.sitive Negative. Rustic fire-side foul; filmic warm-muted grade. Beans are rounder/redder than classic Hijazi foul - plausible stand-in. Keep the pot in the lower half of a 4:5 crop.

name: dish-mutabbaq
subject: Close-up of a griddled stuffed bread cut open, showing a filling of egg, greens and chicken, against a dark background
altEn: A griddled stuffed pastry cut open to show egg and greens inside
altAr: فطيرةٌ محمّرة على الصاج مقطوعةٌ تكشف حشوةً من البيض والخضرة
notes: Unsplash, Fatemeh Rz. Stand-in: thicker bread than a true layered mutabbaq; reads as a stuffed griddled pastry. Shallow depth of field - keep focus band (y 0.4-0.6) in crop.

name: dish-gahwa-service
subject: Brass dallah with small cups beside a woven palm-frond basket of dates, on a straw mat in front of a sadu-patterned floor cushion
altEn: A brass dallah and small coffee cups beside a woven basket of dates
altAr: دلّةٌ نحاسية وفناجينُ صغيرة بجانب سلّةِ خوصٍ ملأى بالتمر
notes: Unsplash, L Photography. Authentic Gulf props (dallah, khoos basket, sadu). Warm indoor light, slightly flashy - grade down. Crop 4:5 between x 0.05-0.75 to drop the white artificial flowers (bottom-left) and green/yellow object on right edge.

name: dish-fattoush-sumac
subject: Leafy salad with spinach, red-veined sorrel, apple slices, walnuts and pomegranate seeds in a black stoneware bowl on grey marble, in hard low sun with long shadows; small cup of dressing
altEn: Leafy salad with pomegranate seeds and walnuts in a black bowl, under hard sunlight
altAr: سلطةُ أوراقٍ خضراء بحبّات الرمّان والجوز في وعاءٍ أسود تحت شمسٍ حادّة
notes: Unsplash, kimia kazemi. Stand-in for fattoush (no crisp bread or sumac visible) chosen for its hard directional sunlight and long shadow - strongly on-concept. Portrait 2800x4192.

name: craft-bread-oven
subject: A gloved hand sliding a stack of sesame bread rings on a peel towards the mouth of a wood-fired oven with open flames and embers
altEn: A gloved hand slides sesame bread rings into a blazing wood-fired oven
altAr: يدٌ بقفّازٍ تُدخل حلقاتِ الخبز بالسمسم إلى فرن حطبٍ مشتعل
notes: Unsplash, Yasin Onus. Hand and forearm only, no face. Flame glow + dark surround = night-courtyard palette.

name: dish-karak-kaak
subject: Close-up of a row of freshly baked sesame-crusted bread rings (ka'ak/simit) on a dark wooden board, warm side light
altEn: Freshly baked sesame bread rings stacked on a dark wooden board
altAr: حلقاتُ كعكٍ بالسمسم خارجةٌ لتوّها من الفرن، مصفوفةٌ على لوحٍ خشبيٍّ داكن
notes: Unsplash, Yasin Onus. Shows the ka'ak only (no karak cup in frame). Same photographer/series as craft-bread-oven - consistent grade. Crop 4:5 around x 0.35-0.75.

name: dish-kleija
subject: Top-down close-up of three round, crackled golden cookies studded with dates and nuts on a white plate over a stone-grey surface
altEn: Three round golden cookies studded with dates and nuts on a white plate
altAr: ثلاثُ قرصاتٍ ذهبية مستديرة مرصّعة بالتمر والمكسّرات في طبقٍ أبيض
notes: Unsplash, VD Photography. Reads as kleija (round, spiced, date-studded). Soft daylight; neutral plate - grade warm.

name: craft-coffee-pour
subject: A hand pouring dark coffee from a carved clay coffee pot into a small white cup on a round wooden tray with a woven ring and scattered coffee beans; warm café light
altEn: A hand pours coffee from a clay pot into a small white cup on a wooden tray
altAr: يدٌ تصبّ القهوة من إبريقٍ فخاري في فنجانٍ أبيض صغير على صينيةٍ خشبية
notes: Unsplash, Amanuel Kebede. Pot is a clay jebena rather than a brass dallah, but the pour, small cup and warm wood read on-concept. Hand only; sleeve top-left. Background bookshelf blurred.

name: craft-kneading
subject: Two floured hands pressing a round of dough into a drift of flour on a worktop, warm side light
altEn: Floured hands press a round of dough into a bed of flour
altAr: يدان مغبّرتان بالطحين تضغطان قرصَ عجينٍ فوق طبقةٍ من الدقيق
notes: Unsplash, Aldward Castillo. Shot list asks landscape; this is portrait 2800x4200 - a 3:2 landscape crop centred at y 0.55 still holds both hands and the dough.

name: craft-embers
subject: Glowing orange-red charcoal embers in darkness, full frame
altEn: Glowing charcoal embers in the dark
altAr: جمرُ فحمٍ متوهّجٌ في العتمة
notes: Unsplash, Gaby Fishman Fosbery. Panoramic 2800x1293 - suits wide bands/backgrounds; not croppable to 4:5 at full height.

name: craft-plating
subject: A chef's hand spooning a dark berry sauce beside a piece of seared meat in a white-glazed, rough grey stoneware bowl, on a riveted metal counter
altEn: A chef's hand spoons dark sauce onto a plated dish in a stoneware bowl
altAr: يدُ طاهٍ تسكب صلصةً داكنة بالملعقة على طبقٍ في وعاءٍ حجري
notes: Unsplash, Ambitious Studio* / Rick Barrett. Hand and forearm only. Water glass blurred behind (not alcohol).

name: craft-spices
subject: Rows of round metal bowls of whole and ground spices (sumac-red, chilli, cardamom, cumin, dried rose, bark) on the ground before an old ochre wooden door
altEn: Metal bowls of whole and ground spices laid out before an old wooden door
altAr: أطباقٌ معدنية من التوابل الكاملة والمطحونة مصفوفةٌ أمام بابٍ خشبيٍّ عتيق
notes: Unsplash, Agnieszka Stankiewicz (Dubai). No hands in frame (shot list asks hands) but strongly on-concept: souq spices, ochre wood, warm light. Portrait; landscape crop around y 0.55-0.85.

name: craft-server-hands
subject: A server in a black shirt holding a long white plate of sliced tomato and white cheese with basil; torso and hands only
altEn: A server's hands carry a white plate of sliced tomatoes and cheese
altAr: يدا نادلٍ تحملان طبقًا أبيض من شرائح الطماطم والجبن
notes: Unsplash, gustavo nacht. Cropped torso/hands, no face. Dark shirt reads as night service.

name: craft-pour-over
subject: A hand pouring freshly brewed coffee from a glass pour-over carafe with wooden collar into a black mug, soft-focus kitchen behind
altEn: A hand pours brewed coffee from a glass pour-over carafe into a black mug
altAr: يدٌ تصبّ القهوة المقطّرة من إبريقٍ زجاجي في كوبٍ أسود
notes: Unsplash, Jakob Owens. Serving pour rather than the brewing step. Pale kitchen cabinets behind - grade warm; crop tighter on carafe + mug.

name: craft-dates-palm
subject: Close-up of strands of yellow and amber khalal dates hanging among palm fronds, sun-warmed, shallow depth of field
altEn: Strands of yellow and amber dates hanging among palm fronds
altAr: عذوقُ بلحٍ أصفر وكهرماني تتدلّى بين سعف النخيل
notes: Unsplash, Raúl Mermans García. 2080x3120 (long edge >= 2000). Warm golden palette.

name: craft-fish-ice
subject: A pile of whole fresh mackerel with iridescent striped backs lying on crushed ice, warm light
altEn: Whole fresh mackerel laid on crushed ice
altAr: أسماكُ إسقمريٍّ طازجة كاملة على جريش الثلج
notes: Unsplash, Sam Farallon. Full-frame fish, no labels or price tags.

name: ing-saffron
subject: Saffron threads in a small ornate silver-and-enamel dish on a cut tree-trunk slab, green cardamom pods spilling from a tipped glass jar behind
altEn: Saffron threads in a small ornate dish beside spilled green cardamom pods on wood
altAr: خيوطُ زعفرانٍ في صحنٍ صغيرٍ مزخرف، وبجانبها حبّاتُ هيلٍ أخضر منثورة على الخشب
notes: Unsplash, Mohammad Amiri. Warm wood; doubles as a cardamom frame. Keep the saffron dish in crop.

name: ing-dried-lime
subject: Full-frame pile of whole dried black limes (loomi), wrinkled tan-to-brown skins, warm low-key light
altEn: A pile of whole dried limes with wrinkled brown skins
altAr: كومةٌ من حبّات اللومي المجفّف بقشورها البنّية المتجعّدة
notes: Unsplash, Ashkan Forouzani. True loomi. Full-frame texture - any crop works.

name: ing-roses
subject: Full-frame close-up of loose pink rose petals and buds
altEn: Loose pink rose petals and buds filling the frame
altAr: بتلاتُ وردٍ وردية وبراعمُ متراكمة تملأ الإطار
notes: Unsplash, Zulfugar Karimov. Pink reads as Taif rose. Saturated - pull magenta slightly toward warm in grade.

name: ing-coffee-beans
subject: Roasted coffee beans spilling from an open burlap sack against a dark background, soft side light
altEn: Roasted coffee beans in an open burlap sack
altAr: حبوبُ قهوةٍ محمّصة في كيسٍ من الخيش
notes: Unsplash, Tina Guina. Low-key, warm brown; generous dark negative space top/right for text.

name: ing-honey
subject: Macro of a glistening piece of honeycomb resting in a pool of golden honey on a white surface, hard sunlight casting a warm shadow
altEn: A piece of honeycomb glistening in a pool of golden honey
altAr: قطعةُ شهدٍ تلمع وسط بركةٍ من العسل الذهبي
notes: Unsplash, Giorgio Trovato. Hard directional light and cast shadow - on-concept. Rejected a floating-honeycomb studio shot that read as CGI.

name: ing-dates
subject: Glossy dark-red dates heaped in a small white bowl with a few scattered in front, on a warm golden surface, shallow depth of field
altEn: Glossy dark dates in a small white bowl, a few scattered in front
altAr: تمراتٌ داكنة لامعة في وعاءٍ أبيض صغير، وبعضها منثورٌ أمامه
notes: Unsplash, VD Photography. Warm golden background; generous space left for type.

name: dish-dates-laban
subject: Dates arranged on a round wooden slice beside a small turned-wood cup and wheat stalks, on a soft grey-brown throw; dappled plant shadow across the corner
altEn: Dates on a round wooden board beside a small wooden cup
altAr: تمراتٌ على لوحٍ خشبيٍّ مستدير بجانب كوبٍ خشبيٍّ صغير
notes: Unsplash, Masjid Pogung Dalangan. No laban or fresh fruit visible - the wooden cup stands in for the laban cup. Soft dappled shade fits the concept. Crop 4:5 around x 0.3-0.8.

name: place-candle-table
subject: Dim, warm restaurant corner: a single candle in a frosted holder glowing on a white-clothed table, bentwood chairs, wood-panelled walls; out-of-focus warm highlight in the foreground
altEn: A single candle glowing on a white-clothed table in a dim, wood-panelled room
altAr: شمعةٌ واحدة تتوهّج على مائدةٍ بمفرشٍ أبيض في قاعةٍ خافتةٍ مكسوّةٍ بالخشب
notes: Unsplash, Sara Abilova. No glasses or bottles visible. Portrait (shot list asks landscape) - landscape crop at y 0.35-0.65 holds the table. Blurred orange blob bottom-left can be cropped.

name: dish-luqaimat
subject: Golden sesame-crusted fried dough balls in a patterned blue-and-white bowl with a spoon, on a warm wooden table with small handmade ceramic cups behind
altEn: Golden sesame-coated dough balls in a patterned bowl on a wooden table
altAr: لقيماتٌ ذهبية مكسوّة بالسمسم في زبديةٍ مزخرفة على طاولةٍ خشبية
notes: Unsplash, Andreas Haubold. Sesame balls (East Asian jian dui) standing in for luqaimat - same golden spheres + sesame; no date syrup visible. Warm, low light; crop 4:5 around the bowl.

name: dish-qursan
subject: Top-down: a dark bowl of meat stew with potato and carrot chunks in brown gravy, beside torn crusty bread and a whole loaf, on a blue-and-white checked cloth with marigolds and a spoon
altEn: A bowl of meat and vegetable stew beside torn pieces of bread
altAr: زبديةُ مرقِ لحمٍ وخضار بجانب قطعٍ من الخبز المقطّع
notes: Unsplash, Laura Ohlman. Stand-in for qursan (stew + bread; bread is a crusty loaf rather than thin qursan sheets). Blue check cloth is a cool accent - grade warm or crop 4:5 tight to bowl + bread.

name: dish-mataziz
subject: A white floral-rimmed bowl of red-orange lamb stew with whole potatoes, on hessian over a warm wooden board, 45-degree view
altEn: A bowl of red lamb stew with potatoes on a wooden table
altAr: زبديةُ مرقِ لحمٍ أحمر مع البطاطس على طاولةٍ خشبية
notes: Unsplash, Rimsha Noor. Stand-in for mataziz: no dough squares visible - reads as a home-style lamb & vegetable stew with the right colour (tomato/pumpkin red). 2800x2800.

name: dish-sundial-morning
subject: Minimal top-down still life: two slices of open-crumb bread above three spoons trailing butter, a glossy amber preserve and a golden crumble, on a pale surface with wide negative space
altEn: Two slices of rustic bread above three spoons of butter, amber preserve and golden crumble
altAr: شريحتا خبزٍ ريفي فوق ثلاث ملاعق: زبدةٌ ومربّى كهرماني وفتاتٌ ذهبي
notes: Unsplash, Alice Pasqual. Tasting-course stand-in for tannour bread, ghee and honey: minimal and composed, but on a pale surface, not dark stoneware. 2000x3000.

name: place-majlis
subject: Long majlis hall with a carved, painted timber ceiling, plastered walls with arched niches and wall lamps, floor cushions in red sadu-pattern lining both sides over red patterned carpets; bookshelves on the right
altEn: A long majlis hall with floor cushions along both walls, red carpets and a carved wooden ceiling
altAr: مجلسٌ طويل تصطفّ على جانبيه الجلساتُ الأرضية، بسجّادٍ أحمر وسقفٍ خشبيٍّ منقوش
notes: Unsplash, Rafael Peier (Oman fort majlis). Shot list asks landscape; this is portrait 2800x4200 - a 3:2 crop at y 0.45-0.8 keeps cushions + carpet. Book spines on the right are tiny and unreadable; crop x<0.85 to drop them entirely.

name: dish-labneh-zaatar
subject: Top-down: a stoneware bowl of swirled, creamy pale dip pooled with olive oil, sprinkled with dried herbs and dill, cucumber wedges on the side, on pale travertine
altEn: A creamy dip swirled with olive oil and dried herbs, cucumber wedges on the side
altAr: صحنٌ من غموسٍ كريمي تتخلّله دوّاماتُ زيت الزيتون والأعشاب المجفّفة، وبجانبه شرائحُ خيار
notes: Unsplash, Andrea Niebuhr. Stand-in: actually hummus (beige rather than labneh-white); the oil + herb sprinkle reads like labneh with za'atar. Shares a look with dish-hummus-ghee - consider a slight cooler/whiter grade to differentiate. No bread or olives visible.

name: dish-masoub
subject: A white plate of small golden pancakes topped with banana slices beside a glass of frothy banana milk, on a bamboo board with a linen napkin, fork and knife
altEn: Golden pancakes topped with banana slices beside a glass of banana milk
altAr: فطائرُ ذهبية صغيرة تعلوها شرائحُ الموز، وبجانبها كأسٌ من حليب الموز
notes: Unsplash, Trinh Le Nguyen Ai. Loose stand-in for masoub (banana + bread + cream); not mashed and served on a plate rather than a bowl. Bright daylight - grade warmer; crop 4:5 on the plate.

name: craft-chef-back
subject: A baker in a flat cap and white shirt, seen from behind over his shoulder, tending a blazing wood-fired oven with long tongs; glowing embers in the firebox below
altEn: A baker seen from behind tends the flames of a wood-fired oven with long tongs
altAr: خبّازٌ من الخلف يقلّب لهيبَ فرن الحطب بملقطٍ طويل
notes: Unsplash, DDP. Shot over the shoulder - face turned away (only ear and glasses arm visible); crop the top ~12% to drop the head entirely if needed. Rejected two frames with T-shirt print / signage and stemware.

name: place-long-table
subject: Quiet courtyard with a weathered, patched plaster wall, gravel floor and two long dark-wood tables with benches; olive and leafy plants in the foreground, soft daylight, no people
altEn: Long wooden tables in a quiet courtyard with a weathered plaster wall and potted plants
altAr: موائدُ خشبية طويلة في فناءٍ هادئ بجدارٍ جصّيٍّ عتيق ونباتاتٍ في الأصص
notes: Unsplash, Elist Nguyen. Tables are not laid for dinner - chosen because every set-table candidate showed wine bottles or stemware. Strongly on-concept courtyard (plaster, gravel, greenery); grade warmer, add hard light in grade if desired.

name: dish-areeka
subject: A hand pouring a thin stream of honey/date syrup from a small glass bottle onto a sage-green bowl of grain porridge topped with flaked almonds, on a woven placemat
altEn: Honey poured over a bowl of grain porridge topped with flaked almonds
altAr: عسلٌ يُسكب على زبديةِ عصيدةٍ من الحبوب يعلوها لوزٌ مبشور
notes: Unsplash, K8. Stand-in for areeka: porridge texture + honey pour; no dates or visible ghee. Bottle has no visible label. Fingertips only at top edge.

name: place-mudbrick
subject: Sun-baked earthen (mud-brick) parapet with rounded merlons, hard sun and deep shadow, palm tops beyond, blue sky with light cloud
altEn: Sun-baked mud-brick parapet with rounded crenellations against a blue sky
altAr: سورٌ طينيٌّ لوّحته الشمس بشرفاتٍ مستديرة تحت سماءٍ زرقاء
notes: Unsplash, mathieu gauzy (North African earthen architecture, not Najdi - no triangular openings). Hard sun + shadow on clay = on-concept. Portrait; landscape crop at y 0.45-0.95. A true Najdi frame (At-Turaif, Commons CC BY) was found but carries a burned-in copyright watermark; another At-Turaif Commons original was blocked by Wikimedia rate limits.

name: dish-balaleet
subject: Nests of fine shredded vermicelli pastry topped with crushed dried rose petals and rosebuds on a white plate, warm light
altEn: Nests of fine vermicelli scattered with dried rose petals and rosebuds
altAr: أعشاشٌ من الشعيرية الرفيعة تتناثر عليها بتلاتُ الورد المجفّف وبراعمُه
notes: Unsplash, Dad hotel. Stand-in: sweet vermicelli with rose (no omelette layer). Replace with a house photograph of balaleet when one is shot.

name: dish-saleeg
subject: A glass dish of milk-white, creamy vermicelli pudding (sheer khurma), lid lifted; terracotta cups and marigolds at the edges
altEn: A creamy, milk-white dish in a glass bowl with its lid lifted
altAr: طبقٌ كريميٌّ أبيض بالحليب في وعاءٍ زجاجيٍّ رُفع غطاؤه
notes: Unsplash, Adil Murshed. Stand-in for saleeg (creamy white rice): the texture and colour read right at menu sizes; crop tight on the bowl to drop the marigolds (x > 0.8). Replace with a house photograph when one is shot.
